investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Amberhollow Clinics (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.104.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster amberh-prod-eastus (AKS); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for patient-portal; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
